'''Station 1B6/Green''' was a [[Bavos-II heavy-duty military space platform|Bavos-II space platform]]. It was placed in [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]], near the edge of the [[Ringali Nebula/Legends|Ringali Nebula]], rimward of [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]] and [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. The station guarded a region that was frequently crossed by vessels that operated on the fringe, such as [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] heading toward and away from [[Ado sector/Legends|Ado sector]] and the [[StarForge Station]].

Like [[Station 2LC/Blue]], 1B6/Green was under the command of [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial naval]] installations at Esseles. Stationed at 1B6/Green were two [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]] and a [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigate]]. Four squadrons of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], a squadron of [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]], and a large quantity of other craft, which included [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]], [[Cargo tug/Legends|cargo tugs]], and [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wings]], rounded out the station's [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] garrison. The station was also surrounded by a ring of [[Type 5 hunter-killer space mine]]s. A direct [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] connection was active with Esseles' Imperial [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]].

[[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Alpiett Gredge]], commander of the [[Scourge (Victory I-class)|''Scourge'']], and who was formerly in charge of 1B6/Green, occasionally visited the station on his patrols as a matter of personal interest. The stations dated back to the time of the [[Esselian Empire]], and originally delineated part of the Esselian border.
